# `admin.user.unlock`

Clear a user lockout

Site admins only. Clears failed-login count and lockout.

- Method and path: `POST /admin/users/{user}/unlock`
- Scope: `admin:write`
- Kind: `mutation`
- CLI: `rukie admin user unlock`
- MCP: `admin_user_unlock`
- Idempotency-Key: required on this mutation

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Idempotency-Key` | header | no | `string` |
| `user` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`forbidden`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
